catalog.title: 1973 Seiko Catalog Vol.2
catalog.note: JDM catalogue '73-2 (watch catalogue 1973 no. 2), men's, ladies', fancy, stopwatch and railway watches. Each caption prints ●model, jewels (石, where printed) and number, e.g. '●56GAW 25石 020' -> ref 56GAW-020 (the printed line is kept in `code`; ladies' numbers carry an R-/S-/A- prefix, e.g. 11SL-R-107), then the model name and feature lines (translated into `specs`/`notes`), the case material·WR line (SS, HSS, SGP, TSGP, GC, PMP, PDP, NSB, WGP, WGPG, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade plated, AGF/AWGF, SILV, SILP, CRP, ALM light alloy, 14K·WG, 18K; WR water-resistant, RP rainproof) with the list price (円), and a bracketed case-dial number <600-600> kept as `caseDialCode`. Where the model is a four-digit number (2220, 2201, 2406, 2409, 2415, 2418, 2431, 2435, 1700, 1944, 6117, 6618) it is the movement and is stored as `caliber`; family codes (56GAW, 52KAW, 61-5A, 11SL, 22MLQ, 88ST …) leave it blank. No CCCC-NNNN case refs and no bracelet/strap codes are printed; the pictured strap or bracelet is described in `notes`. Where a printed price has a different price written in by hand, both are kept in `price`. The front photo spread (scan 5-8, printed pp. 1-4, 特選腕時計 special selection) prints its captions in dark type on red and gold cloth with no case-dial numbers; on scan 6 they are faint and one price (39SQC-022) cannot be read. Scan index n shows printed page n-4; scan 12, 42, 56, 62-72, 76, 80, 96, 98, 128 and 137-143 are empty blue photo panels (no watches) in this copy.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders of all 146 scan pages (Oct 2026), one record per pictured watch in reading order, verified against full-resolution caption crops and cross-checked with the PDF text layer; photo boxes from a panel-aware detector plus hand-set boxes, all checked on per-page check sheets.
